# ephone 1.0.2 corresponding source

The Android app includes the unmodified `ephone@1.0.2` JavaScript/WebAssembly engine and its complete language pack from npm.

- Upstream: https://github.com/sjmik/ephone-js
- Tag: `v1.0.2`
- Commit: `4f6d246c1d3acf67a4d814e20da02fa3967bc92d`
- Source archive: `ephone-js-1.0.2-source.tar.gz`
- Archive URL: https://codeload.github.com/sjmik/ephone-js/tar.gz/4f6d246c1d3acf67a4d814e20da02fa3967bc92d
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later (inherited from eSpeak NG)
- Build instructions: upstream `README.md`, `emscripten/README.md`, `emscripten/build.sh`, `emscripten/build-multiple.sh`.

The archive is provided alongside the Android source distribution. The application uses the unmodified npm release; no compiler output inside it has been edited.
